LoyaltyPgmCurrencyExtPrd.name: LoyaltyPgmCurrencyExtPrd
LoyaltyPgmCurrencyExtPrd.description: Represents an additional timeframe beyond the standard expiration date for redeeming or reinstating points. It enables tier-based flexibility, allowing certain members more time to utilize their points before they are forfeited.

ExtensionDuration.description: The duration of the extension. It's used with ExtensionDurationUnit to specify the extension period.

ExtensionDurationUnit.description: The unit of time for the extension duration.

ExtensionType.description: Specifies the type of extension period.

IsExpiryExempt.description: Indicates whether points are exempt from expiry.

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user referenced the record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user viewed the record.

LoyaltyProgramCurrencyId.description: The loyalty program currency associated with the record.

LoyaltyProgramId.description: The loyalty program associated with the record.

LoyaltyTierId.description: The loyalty tier associated with the record.

TargetAudienceReferenceId.description: Specifies the tier for which to determine eligibility for expiry extension or reinstatement.
